title: Trapezoidal channel, velocity at a given depth (FHWA HDS-4 Example 4.1)

source.citation: FHWA, Introduction to Highway Hydraulics, HDS-4 (June 1997, metric), Example 4.1

verification: Re-derived by script (Python, outside the repository): A = 1.5 m², P = 2 + 2 × 0.5 × √5 = 4.2361 m, R = 0.35410 m, V = 1.3707 m/s, Q = 2.0561 m³/s. The book rounds R to 0.35 m before computing V, giving 1.36 m/s; the velocity tolerance is widened to 1 % to cover that intermediate rounding (ENGINEERING_STANDARDS §3). The book's Q ≈ 2.0 m³/s is not checked: it follows from the rounded V (1.36 × 1.5 = 2.04) and Example 4.2 already checks the discharge. Source erratum, recorded and not used: the book prints the discharge unit as m²/s.
